chapters.title: Start From a Frozen Behavior Baseline
Inspect the Model and Tokenizer Boundary

figures.alt: A frozen baseline vault separates an identified baseline from a candidate and locks contract, configuration, evaluation, budgets, and controls before comparison.
figures.evidenceRole: Explains comparison identity without implying production approval.

figures.alt: A falsifiable chain connects an observed error to a proposed mechanism, intervention, predicted evidence, and explicit rejection gates.
figures.evidenceRole: Explains disconfirmation structure without predicting an adaptation outcome.

figures.alt: A cutaway model system shows tokens entering embeddings and transformer blocks before a prediction head, with precision recorded as a separate runtime surface.
figures.evidenceRole: Separates compatibility surfaces without ranking performance.

figures.alt: The same Gujarati-English shorthand string is divided differently by tokenizer A and tokenizer B, producing visibly different sequence lengths without asserting which is better.
figures.evidenceRole: Shows token boundary and length differences without a multilingual quality claim.

figures.alt: A gated intervention ladder moves from repair through supervised and parameter-efficient tuning, preference optimization, distillation, continued pretraining, and replacement, with a stop gate at every rung.
figures.evidenceRole: Maps mechanisms and stop gates; height does not imply quality or maturity.

figures.alt: Intervention candidates are filtered through access, data, compute, control, and reversibility gates before one bounded pilot investigation remains.
figures.evidenceRole: Explains feasibility gates without reporting a real budget or approval.

limitations: Mosaic Desk artifacts, failures, token traces, budgets, methods, and dispositions are fictional and synthetic.
The inherited Volume 1 negative adaptation and migration states remain unchanged; the new shorthand population is distinct.
Compatibility fixtures prove validator mechanics only, not real model compatibility, quality, capacity, rights, privacy, or security.
Method cases are configuration-bound; no Tülu, LoRA, QLoRA, DPO, distillation, or continued-pretraining result transfers to Mosaic.
Figure records describe accepted ImageGen PNG teaching assets; this visual gate does not assert publication or runtime behavior.
